meta.label: Week 9 · Sun–Mon
meta.model_version: v4.1 · trained model + Action Network prices
meta.prices_et: Action Network · Thu Nov 5, 7:57 PM ET
meta.injuries_et: Official NFL injury report via nflverse (Sunday teams report Friday; this run is preliminary)

calibration.note: Temperature on the log-odds, fit walk-forward on earlier 2026 weeks only.

backtest.leakage: PASS: no feature on or before the scrambled week moved; later weeks did (features do use the past)
backtest.game_line_verdict: Trained game model lost to the closing line every season 2022–2026, so game numbers shown are the market, with outcome spread learned from data.

rules: Market must be one where the calibrated model beat the DraftKings line out of sample (receptions, receiving yards).
Calibrated chance of 55% or more on the side.
No out-of-distribution flag (backup QB with almost no NFL snaps, return from absence, under 3 prior games, new starting QB, features outside the training range).
Team invariants pass (target shares ≤ 100%; receivers and QB within 10%).
Bet: edge of 3+ points over the break-even of the best price, and the 10th percentile of the bootstrap interval (refit on games resampled with replacement) also above break-even.
No bet above a 75% chance (Lopez, Matthews & Baumer ceiling check).
A book is ignored when its no-vig price is more than 8 points from the other books (stale price).
At most 15 bets per slate, 1u each at most, 15u total.
Rushing and passing yards never become bets: the model lost to the no-vig market there in the 2026 priced backtest.
meta.staking: Units are reduced Kelly (Kelly 1956) shrunk by the bootstrap uncertainty (Baker & McHale 2013), 1u = 1% of bankroll, capped at 1u per bet and 15u per slate.

funnel.step: Model can predict (not out-of-distribution, passes invariants)
Market where the model beat the line out of sample (receptions, receiving yards)
Priced at a sportsbook (Action Network: DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM, BetRivers, Caesars)
Edge of 3+ points over break-even at the best price
Interval (bootstrap by game) clears break-even, validated market, no flags = Bet

meta.histogram_note: 10,000 simulations per prop, linked to the game script by a correlation learned from 2026 data.
meta.method: Two trained models per market (LightGBM quantile regression; hierarchical Negative Binomial volume × Efron–Morris shrunk efficiency), chosen by calibrated log loss at the market line in a 2026 week-by-week walk-forward. Features use only earlier games plus pregame structured inputs; a leakage test that scrambles one week of results passes.

sim.note: Team scoring means are the closing market (the trained game model lost to the close 2022–2026); spread of outcomes and the home/away link are learned from 2,000+ games.
